messages.content: 你能使用 get_stock_prices 函數來檢索蘋果、微軟、亞馬遜和特斯拉分別在1週、2週、3週和1個月的時間範圍內的股價嗎？。

function.name: get_stock_prices
function.description: Retrieves stock prices for specified companies and duration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

companies.description: List of companies to retrieve stock prices for.

duration.description: Time duration to retrieve stock prices for. E.g., '1 week', '2 weeks', '1 month', etc.

message.reasoning:
The user wants us to use the get_stock_prices function to fetch Apple (AAPL), Microsoft (MSFT), Amazon (AMZN) and Tesla (TSLA). They want separate durations: "1 week", "2 weeks", "3 weeks" and "1 month". The question says "for each company respectively"? It might mean we need to call with different durations per company? Or maybe they want all four companies across those time ranges.

Interpretation: Use get_stock_prices to retrieve stock prices for specified companies and duration. Provide list of companies and duration as arguments. But we have multiple durations; perhaps we should make separate calls or combine into one request if possible. The function signature expects an array of companies and a single duration. So cannot pass multiple durations at once. We could do separate calls:

Call #1: companies ["Apple"], duration "1 week"
Call #2: companies ["Microsoft"], duration "2 weeks"
Call #3: companies ["Amazon"], duration "3 weeks"
Call #4: companies ["Tesla"], duration "1 month"

Alternatively, group them but then they'd share same duration which isn't what asked.

Thus produce four calls using tool invocation format. We'll output JSON objects accordingly. Let's proceed.
